name: io.github.tonyyang0504/customcat-mcp
description: CustomCat (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, create_order, get_order, track. Every tool maps

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CUSTOMCAT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: CustomCat API key (generated per 'API Custom Integrations' store; Settings in the app shows a read-only and a read-write key — create_order needs the read-write one), sent as the `api_key` parameter.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CUSTOMCAT_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to send `sandbox: 1` with create_order and get_order (CustomCat's sandbox flag); left out when unset, so orders are real and charged.
